title: olea europaea subsp. africana
intro: Olea europaea subsp. africana, commonly known as the African olive tree, is a subspecies of the olive tree native to the Mediterranean region and parts of Africa. This tree is rich in health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high levels of antioxidants and polyphenols. The therapeutic actions of Olea europaea subsp. africana include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and the management of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oleuropein, hydroxytyrosol, and tyrosol, which are responsible for its numerous health benefits and therapeutic actions.
